blocks.text: What is the progressive rate system?

runs: Korean residential (low-voltage) electricity billing uses a
: as usage increases, each tier is billed at a higher unit price. The basic (base) fee is also set by whichever tier your total usage reaches.
, the tier thresholds are relaxed to account for higher air-conditioner use (tier 1: 200→300kWh, tier 2: 400→450kWh).

The rates used here are a reference compiled from cross-checked sources — for the exact current rate, check KEPCO’s official site (Han-jeon ON). VAT (10%) and the Electric Power Industry Fund levy (3.7%) are added as estimates, and this doesn’t replicate your actual bill’s rounding-to-the-nearest-10-won rule.
